protocol.success: No termination during 500 steps AND per-world final-second RMSE < 0.10 (Figure8 < 0.15); Landing additionally final-second speed RMSE < 0.10 m/s
protocol.optimization_log_precision: Rounded trainer logs; exact reward/error history is separately preserved
protocol.autoreset: Official NEXT_STEP autoreset; evaluation remains a fixed 500-step stream
protocol.episode_return_definition: Mean per-world sum over 500 evaluated steps; can cross resets after failure
protocol.position_teacher: ReachPos and Landing: 1000 BC batches before PPO; imitation coefficient 10 during PPO
protocol.velocity_teacher: Disabled by default: 0 BC batches and imitation coefficient 0
protocol.initial_episode_return_null: No completed episode yet; not a failed numeric training scalar
protocol.counts_precision: Counts recovered from logged rate times 256 (six decimal rate uniquely identifies integer count)
protocol.timing: PPO elapsed starts before the rollout loop, excludes prior BC/environment setup, and includes any first-step JIT compilation inside that loop. process_wall_seconds also includes setup, BC and final evaluation/plotting; shared GPU work affects timing.
